object.Title: Christ holding a globe and blessing
object.Medium: ink and pigments on medium-weight, light-cream-colored parchment, well surfaced on both sides; miniatures on heavier parchment
object.Description:
This historiated initial is illuminated by the Masters of Zweder van Culemborg.

For the latest information about this object, Christ holding a globe and blessing, visit the Online Collection of the Walters Art Museum.
object.Provenance: Libraire Morgand, number 26084, 19th century; Henry Walters, Baltimore, before 1931 [mode of acquisition unknown]; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
object.MuseumLocation: To learn whether this object is now on view, and in which gallery, visit https://purl.thewalters.org/art/W.168.149R
